title: Multilingual Contextual Affective Analysis of LGBT People Portrayals in Wikipedia

bias_targets.methodology: Using contextual affective analysis to measure differences in power, agency, and sentiment between multilingual Wikipedia biography pages of LGBT individuals and a matched control group of non-LGBT individuals.

Comparing the contextual affective scores (power, agency, and sentiment) of the exact same LGBT individuals across English, Russian, and Spanish Wikipedia editions to identify culturally specific framing, narratives, and stereotypes.
